Shanghai Municipal Police.
（批：190 FILED 16.4.18）

CENTRAL POLICE Station.
16th April, 1918.

REPORT ON Nielsen's Connections with Rebels.

Made by D.S.I.Givens. Forwarded by

Sir,

Although rumours have been current during the past three years that Nielsen, the German spy and gun runner, was assisting Chinese revolutionaries, the statement of Chang Sau Liang (章少良) was the first information of a definite character about this matter to reach the Police.

Nielsen had illicit dealings with a bath shop keeper named Zung Jung Ling (程润林), 700 Fokien Road, in September 1916. Hitherto it was thought that these illicit dealings had to do with opium, but they may very well have been of a more serious character.

A Chinese named Tsu Oo Chun (朱五均) and Nielsen kept a chemist's shop at No. 108 Chaotung Road from the end of 1915 till the early part of 1917. Many Chinese used to visit this shop, some of whom might have been rebel plotters.

In the latter part of 1915, Nielsen had a room at No. 1a Jinkee Road, where he kept chemicals and chemical appliances. He used to visit this room almost daily after office hours, and it is possible that he was making bombs or parts of bombs there.

In June 1916 Nielsen was reported to be making bombs in Chapei. An attempt to locate the alleged bomb factory was unsuccessful.

If the story about Nielsen making bombs be correct, it is probable that they were intended for the rebels.

Your obedient servant,
JGivens D.S.I.

C.D.I.

关于尼尔森与革命党人联系的报告。

由副督察吉文斯 (D.S.I. Givens) 撰写。经转呈

先生，

尽管过去三年间一直有谣言称，德国间谍兼军火走私商尼尔森正在协助中国革命党人，但章少良 (Chang Sau Liang) 的陈述是警方收到的关于此事的第一份确切性质的情报。

1916年9月，尼尔森与一名名为程润林 (Zung Jung Ling) 的浴室店主进行了非法交易，该浴室位于福建路700号。此前认为这些非法交易与鸦片有关，但它们完全可能具有更严重的性质。

一名名为朱五均 (Tsu Oo Chun) 的华人与尼尔森从1915年底至1917年初在兆通路108号经营一家化学药品店。许多华人常光顾此店，其中一些人可能是革命阴谋策划者。

1915年下半年，尼尔森在金基路 (Jinkee Road) 1a号有一个房间，他在那里存放化学品和化学器具。他通常在办公时间后几乎每天前往该房间，有可能他在那里制造炸弹或炸弹部件。

1916年6月，有人报告称尼尔森在闸北制造炸弹。试图 locate 所谓的炸弹工厂未获成功。

如果关于尼尔森制造炸弹的说法属实，那么这些炸弹很可能是为革命党人准备的。

您顺从的仆人，
J. 吉文斯 副督察

刑事侦缉督察长

Shanghai Municipal Police
Central Police Station.
August 4th, 1916.

REPORT ON Alleged Intention of A. Nielsen and Rosier Walt to
Leave Shanghai.

Made by D.S.Givens. Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.

Sir,
I beg to report that I saw Mr. Mann of the Finance Department
last evening, and he informed me that at 4.30 p.m. A. Nielsen and
Rosier Walt had called to get some money owing to them by the
Council. The parties had told the Chinese clerks that they wanted
the money immediately, as they were leaving Shanghai last night.
A. Nielsen is the German who has figured so prominently in the
arms traffic, and Rosier Walt is the wife of Moritz Umlauf of
the Gas Kitchen, 112 Broadway. Enquiries go to show that neither
of the parties named left Shanghai last night. Mr. Mann did not
speak to them himself, and his information is based on what one
of his Chinese clerk told him.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D.S.Givens
Detective Sergeant.

Chief Detective Inspector.

关于 A. 尼尔森和罗西尔·沃尔特 (Rosier Walt) 涉嫌意图离开上海的报告。

由副督察吉文斯 (D.S. Givens) 撰写。经首席侦探督察转呈。

先生，
谨报告，我昨晚会见了财务部的曼恩 (Mann) 先生，他告知我，下午4点30分，A. 尼尔森和罗西尔·沃尔特前来领取工部局欠他们的款项。当事人告诉华籍职员他们急需这笔钱，因为他们将于昨晚离开上海。
A. 尼尔森是在军火交易中极为活跃的德国人，而罗西尔·沃尔特是百老汇路112号“Gas Kitchen”（煤气厨房/餐馆）莫里茨·乌姆劳夫 (Moritz Umlauf) 的妻子。调查显示，上述两人均未于昨晚离开上海。曼恩先生并未亲自与他们交谈，他的信息基于其一名华籍职员告诉他的内容。

先生，我是
您顺从的仆人，
D.S. 吉文斯
侦探警佐。

首席侦探督察。

Shanghai Municipal Police. 196
23/3/16.
Central Police Station.
March 13th 191 6.

REPORT ON Alleged Storage of Dangerous Substances in
Settlement and a Soap Factory on the Border.

Made by D.S.Givens Forwarded by

Sir,
Regarding attached, I beg to report that the firm of
Gustav Boehm, No. 8B Kiangse Road, are managers and agents of
a soap factory situated in Chinese territory on the Siccawei
Creek, a short distance to the East of Route Prosper Paris. This
establishment has been under suspicion since the commencement of
the war. Arms were said to have been stored and transported from
there during last year. An Italian named Paraboni, who has
now left the place, is said to have figured in the business
mentioned. Owing to the laws forbidding trading with the enemy,
the establishment ran short of soda some four months ago, and it
was thought for a time that it would be obliged to close down.
Since then it has succeeded in getting supplies of the substance
mentioned through some neutral, and business is now going on as
usual. As far as I can learn glycerine is the only one of the
chemicals named which is kept in any quantity in this factory.
Nos 128, 129, 108 and 109 Chao Tung Road are occupied by persons
carrying on the chemistry business. Nielsen is the owner of the
two first addresses, and is also interested in the concerns at the
two latter addresses, although they are ostensibly owned by
Chinese. As far as can be learned, none of the substances
mentioned are stored in nos 128 and 129 Chao Tung Road.
Chlorate of Potash, Sulphuric acid and glycerine are sold
publicly in the shop at Nos 108 and 109. I have been informed
that their present stock consists of 10 pounds carbonate of
potash, 20 bottles of sulphuric acid, and 200 pounds of glycerine.

I am, Sir,
your obedient servant,
D.S.Givens D.I.

（左侧批注：Seen / AM / 3/5）
（左下角标注：6.D.9.）

关于租界内及边界肥皂厂涉嫌储存危险物质的报告。

由副督察吉文斯 (D.S. Givens) 撰写 经转呈

先生，
关于附件，谨报告如下：位于江西路8B号的古斯塔夫·伯姆 (Gustav Boehm) 商行是一家肥皂厂的经理人和代理人，该厂位于徐家汇浜畔的中国地界，距普恩济世路 (Route Prosper Paris) 以东不远处。自战争爆发以来，该场所一直受到怀疑。据说去年曾有武器在此储存并转运。一名名为帕拉博尼 (Paraboni) 的意大利人（现已离开该地）据称参与了上述业务。由于禁止与敌国贸易的法律，该场所约四个月前纯碱短缺，曾一度被认为将被迫关闭。此后，它通过某中立国成功获得了上述物质的供应，目前业务照常进行。据我所知，甘油是该厂大量储存的唯一一种上述化学品。
兆通路128、129、108和109号由从事化学生意的人士占用。尼尔森是前两个地址的所有者，也对后两个地址的企业拥有权益，尽管它们名义上由华人所有。据查，兆通路128和129号未储存任何上述物质。
氯酸钾、硫酸和甘油在108和109号的店铺公开出售。获悉他们目前的库存包括10磅碳酸钾、20瓶硫酸和200磅甘油。

先生，我是
您顺从的仆人，
D.S. 吉文斯 侦探督察。

（左侧批注：已阅 / AM / 5月3日）
（左下角标注：6.D.9.）

Form 3. 34
Shanghai Municipal Police.
190
Central Police Station.
June 7th 1916.
REPORT ON Information re Activity of Germans in making Bombs, etc.
FILED
Made by D.S.Givens. Forwarded by
Sir,
Enquiries made re attached go to show that "Mount Pleasant"
No.24 N.Honan Road Extension, which is a public gambling house,
is the only building in the vicinity of the Commercial Press
that could possibly be used by Nielsen and his friends. On an
addition, which was recently made to this building, there is
an outside staircase by which one can gain entrance to the upper
story, but the ground floor doors are always open. If Here Germans
are making bombs and passports in "Mount Pleasant", they are most
probably doing so in one of the upstairs rooms of the addition
referred to.
but I have failed to find
any confirmation of the information that they are doing so.
On the contrary I have been told by a frequent visitor to the
resort that it is extremely unlikely that such is the case.
Persons of all nationalities are admitted to Mount Pleasant, and
it is improbable that Germans would start plotting in their midst.
Nielsen is at present staying in the German Club, Room No 4, and
seems to be keeping very quiet. He spends most of the day in
his dispensary at No 128 Chao Tung Road. It is said that
Nielsen has lost the confidence of the bulk of his fellow
countrymen in Shanghai, who consider his schemes far fetched and
unpractical. He has recently told his friends that he intends
to try to get away to Japan soon.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D S Givens
Detective Sergeant.

已归档
由副督察吉文斯 (D.S. Givens) 撰写。经转呈
先生，
对附件相关内容的调查显示，“Mount Pleasant”（快乐山/欢娱楼），位于河南路延伸段24号，是一家公共赌场，是商务印书馆附近唯一可能被尼尔森及其朋友使用的建筑。在该建筑最近增建的部分，有一个外部楼梯可通往上层，但底层大门总是敞开的。如果德国人确实在“Mount Pleasant”制造炸弹和护照，他们极有可能在上述增建部分的上层房间之一中进行。
但我未能找到任何证实他们正在这样做的信息。
相反，一位该场所的常客告诉我，这种情况极不可能发生。
“Mount Pleasant”允许所有国籍的人进入，德国人不太可能在众人之中开始策划阴谋。
尼尔森目前住在德国俱乐部4号房间，似乎保持非常低调。他白天大部分时间待在兆通路128号的药房。据说尼尔森已失去上海大多数同胞的信任，他们认为他的计划异想天开且不切实际。他最近告诉朋友，他打算尽快设法前往日本。
先生，我是
您顺从的仆人，
D S 吉文斯
侦探警佐。
（印章：特别科 1916年6月9日）

page_data.en:
" A large building at the back of the Commercial Press
building - probably that known as Mount Pleasant on North Honan
Road Extension, which is rented by one CARLOS GARCIA, is being
used as a meeting place by NIELSEN and numerous other Germans.

The lower part of the building is never opened, an
entry to the second floor being made by means of a ladder - Work
goes on all night.

It is believed that the Germans are employed in faking
passports or making bombs. "
page_data.zh:
“商务印书馆大楼后面的一座大型建筑——可能是位于河南路延伸段、由一名卡洛斯·加西亚 (CARLOS GARCIA) 承租的所谓‘Mount Pleasant’（快乐山/欢娱楼）——正被尼尔森和众多其他德国人用作集会地点。

该建筑的下部从未开放，进入二楼需借助梯子——工作通宵进行。

据信，德国人正从事伪造护照或制造炸弹的工作。”
